Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

Location:

- UK remote

-Barcelona , Spain


Your Team

  • You will be an integral member of our EMEA Solutions Implementation team within the Servigistics Business Unit.
  • Our team focuses on helping customers adopt best practices in Service Parts Management and designing solutions that enable successful implementations.
  • We are passionate about Service Supply Chain and help our customers achieve their desired service levels in the aftermarket while optimizing inventory investment.
  • You will join a highly skilled, multicultural, collaborative, and results-oriented consulting team working with customers across multiple industries and geographies.

Your Impact

  • Act as an Application Architect / Solution Consultant on Servigistics implementation projects.
  • Work primarily with Servigistics Service Parts Management, with potential exposure to Service Parts Pricing.
  • Lead and facilitate customer workshops to understand business requirements, identify opportunities for improvement, and define solutions using Servigistics.
  • Help customers adopt Service Supply Chain best practices and improve key business outcomes such as service levels, parts availability, and inventory optimization.
  • Design solutions for complex Service Supply Chain and Service Parts Planning business scenarios.
  • Translate business requirements into functional and technical solution designs.
  • Identify opportunities for additional process consulting and solution improvement activities.
  • Support and mentor other team members in the Service Supply Chain and Servigistics domains.

Day-to-Day

  • Present Servigistics capabilities and recommend solution designs that address key customer business challenges.
  • Lead requirements gathering, solution design, and customer-facing workshops.
  • Analyze and communicate both technical and business information to customer stakeholders.
  • Configure and support the implementation of Service Parts Planning solutions.
  • Provide customer training on Servigistics functionality, processes, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with project managers, technical consultants, architects, and customer teams throughout the implementation lifecycle.
  • Contribute to the development and knowledge growth of other consultants within the Service Supply Chain domain.
  • Support project management activities when required.
  • Travel to customer locations for workshops, implementation activities, and other project needs, with approximately 10% travel expected.

Your Skills and Knowledge

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Management, Supply Chain, or a related field.
  • Previous professional experience in Supply Planning, Service Parts Planning, Inventory Planning, or Supply Chain Planning.
  • Previous hands-on experience with Service Parts Planning software is required. Experience with Servigistics as a key-user or consultant is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Service Supply Chain, inventory planning, forecasting, replenishment, or Service Parts Management concepts.
  • Proven ability to lead and facilitate customer-facing workshops.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into functional solution designs.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work effectively with customers and distributed international teams.
  • Availability to travel approximately 10% of the time.
  • Experience managing or supporting IT implementation projects is a plus.

Life at PTC

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

If you share our passion for solving complex problems through innovation and want to help leading organizations transform their Service Supply Chains, we’d love to hear from you.

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

Position Purpose: Completes Qualified Health Plans (QHP) federal and/or state required application templates and documents for low, medium and high risk states, including policy forms for individual commercial marketplace products. Reviews and provides interpretation of application instructions from regulatory agencies Department of Insurance (DOI) and Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS)) and assists in the development of and implementation of auditing and monitoring strategies for high-risk states. Develops and leads special projects and large initiatives, representing the department as a subject matter expert in cross-functional forums. Assume a non-disciplinary supervisory role within Regulatory Operations for the purpose of mentoring junior staff members in their professional growth and support of Centene business goals.

Key Details: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J -1, OPT, or CPT.

  • Prepares and oversees completion of Qualified Health Plan templates and/or formal regulatory filing documents, seeking approval of our individual commercial marketplace health plans for Health Insurance Oversight System (HIOS) and System for Electronic Rates & Forms Filing (SERFF)filings for high-risk states, ensuring quality control, compliance with State and Federal regulations as well as organizational standards, and compliance with internal Company operations, products and financial arrangements. Mentors and oversees completion of work by junior team members.

  • Audits QHP documents for low-medium-high risk states ensuring quality control, compliance with State and Federal regulations as well as organizational standards, and compliance with internal Company operations, products and financial arrangements. Coordinates and oversees audits for the department.

  • Develops and implements continuous improvement activities targeting build, audit and quality initiative strategies.

  • Leads management of Sources of Truth (SOT) documents for Qualified Health Plan (QHP) filing template and policy form development. Continuously supports SOT creation process and audits complex data inputs across SOT documents and/or as determined by DOI and CMS requirements. SOT is relied on by numerous cross functional teams for benefit and cost share information which is utilized in public and member facing documents.

  • Attends, engages and represents their Regulatory Operations team in dynamic cross functional meetings to ensure currency of information related to regulatory and/or market landscape. Leads cross functional teams in data review to ensure Qualified Health Plan (QHP) filing documents are accurate and align with product intent.

  • Independently analyzes proposed and/or enacted federal and state legislation and/or regulatory orders to determine impacts to QHP and regulatory filing documents. Interpret regluations and provides impacts and/or risks related to their functional responsibilities which is utilized for advocacy and implementation needs. Leads implementation of new regulations/legislation impacting QHP scope of work and performs updates to policy and filing documents related to implementation. Assists junior staff in their reviews.

  • Leads cross-functional implementation of passed legislation or new regulations impacting Qualified Health Plan (QHP) scope of work and/or related policy forms and filing templates.

  • Leads onboarding of new employees and training of analysts on essential job duties; maintains and updates training materials. Mentors junior staff in their professional growth.

  • Coordinates, develops, monitors, and lead projects internal to the department and cross-functional business partners, acting as a subject matter expert for the department.

  • May attend external and/or virtual conferences and seminars to evaluate industry trends.
  • Performs other duties as assigned

  • Complies with all policies and standards

Education/Experience:
Bachelor's Degree in Business, Communications, Health Care, Political Science or equivalent experience required: Master's Degree in a related field preferred
6+ years business process or data analysis experience in health insurance, legal, or compliance or related area required
Experience in commercial health insurance and/or behavioral health managed care preferred
Experience drafting and auditing filing documentation (Summary of Benefit Coverage, Schedule of Benefits, etc.), QHP Templates (Plans and Benefit, Pharmacy, Crosswalk, etc.) or related area preferred
Experience auditing database or QHP filing documentation preferred
Experience analyzing legislation and/or regulations and conveying findings preferred
Knowledge of SERFF and HIOS systems preferred

Pay Range: $87,700.00 - $157,800.00 per year

At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.

Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.

Our focus on data science, machine learning, and generative AI helps tech-forward companies level up their employees' skills and drive innovation.

We are looking for an experienced B2B Content Manager to own our global content strategy and build an AI-assisted content operation from the ground up. You’ll combine hands-on content creation for enterprise audiences with designing scalable AI workflows and quality controls.

What you will do

  • Own and develop the global B2B content strategy, aligning content with enterprise audiences, buying committees, positioning, and pipeline goals.
  • Create high-quality content across formats, including website and landing page copy, paid advertising, whitepapers, case studies, thought leadership, social, video scripts, and sales enablement materials.
  • Build and operate an AI-assisted content production system, including prompt libraries, context engineering, source-of-truth repositories, workflows, and human review gates.
  • Partner with Product, Sales, and regional Marketing teams to turn complex AI products and customer needs into clear, compelling enterprise messaging.
  • Own editorial quality and consistency across all B2B content, continuously improving content based on performance data and new AI capabilities.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in B2B content marketing, including 3+ years creating content for technical or enterprise audiences with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Strong portfolio of personally written content, including whitepapers, case studies, website copy, and paid acquisition content.
  • Proven experience building and running AI-assisted content production in a real production environment, not just using consumer AI tools ad hoc.
  • Hands-on experience designing AI content systems, including prompt libraries, context engineering, source-of-truth repositories, multi-step/agentic workflows, and human review gates.
  • Strong range across content formats; experience limited mainly to blogs or SEO content is not sufficient.
  • Native-equivalent written English and the ability to work autonomously with senior stakeholders in a distributed team.

What we can offer you

  • Remote, full-time collaboration;
  • Monthly Base Payment $4000 - $5000 gross pending aligned experience and skills;
  • Annual bonus system;
  • Digital office. We use modern digital tools like Miro, Notion, Slack, etc., to keep our teamwork smooth;

  • Room to grow. Our product is expanding rapidly, so it's a great chance to join and challenge yourself;

We're excited to get to know you and work together!

Como Founding Customer Lead no te limitas a resolver tickets: eres la voz del cliente español dentro de la empresa. Ayudas a que cada prueba gratuita se convierta en un cliente activo y satisfecho, y construyes desde cero los procesos que harán crecer este mercado.

Tareas

Soporte y resolución de problemas

  • Atiendes directamente a nuestros clientes en España por chat, teléfono y pantalla compartida.
  • Analizas los problemas, los resuelves y, cuando hace falta, los escalas de forma clara al equipo adecuado.

Onboarding y conversión

  • Entiendes el caso de uso de cada cliente y le acompañas en la configuración.
  • Haces seguimiento de las pruebas gratuitas inactivas y eliminas lo que frena la decisión de compra.

Conocimiento del mercado español

Contenido y transferencia de conocimiento

Tu éxito se mide en algo muy concreto: más clientes activos y de pago en España.

  • Te gusta hablar con clientes y lo haces con naturalidad, también por teléfono.
  • Escribes de forma clara y estructurada.
  • Tienes curiosidad técnica: quieres entender por qué algo no funciona, no solo que no funciona.
  • Tienes olfato comercial y sabes cuándo un cliente necesita un empujón para decidirse.
  • Ves los procesos como algo que se puede mejorar y te gusta construir desde cero.
  • Trabajas desde España.

Beneficios

  • Un rol fundacional: construyes el mercado español desde el primer día y tus decisiones se notan.
  • 100 % remoto desde España, en una empresa que trabaja completamente en remoto.
  • Responsabilidades claras y apoyo: sabes exactamente qué se espera de ti, y los errores se ven como oportunidades para aprender.
  • Compromiso compartido con resultados excepcionales: un equipo que busca la excelencia y valora tu aportación como imprescindible.
  • Desarrollo individual y autonomía: fomentamos la iniciativa propia y la responsabilidad personal.
  • Feedback directo y continuo, para que puedas adaptarte rápido y seguir aprendiendo.
  • Comunicación abierta y crecimiento profesional: diálogo transparente y apoyo activo en tu desarrollo.
  • Foco en soluciones y resultados, con reconocimiento real por tu compromiso.

Proceso de selección

  1. Una primera llamada breve para conocernos.
  2. Una simulación práctica de unos 90 minutos con casos ficticios basados en situaciones habituales: diagnosticar un problema de portal, una conversación con un cliente en prueba, un ejercicio de documentación y una charla sobre prioridades.
  3. Conversación final con el equipo.

¿Te ves construyendo GetMyInvoices en España? Envíanos tu CV en español o inglés. No hace falta carta de presentación: unas líneas sobre por qué te interesa el rol son suficientes. Si necesitas alguna adaptación durante el proceso de selección, dínoslo y lo organizamos.

Valoramos la diversidad y tratamos todas las candidaturas por igual, con independencia de género, origen, nacionalidad, religión o creencias, discapacidad, edad, orientación sexual o identidad de género. No necesitas incluir foto, fecha de nacimiento, estado civil ni tu salario actual o anterior.

Trataremos tus datos solo para este proceso de selección, conforme al RGPD.

raw.description:
Role - Script Writer

Work Location -Remote

About Lokal:

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV) Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony) Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal) Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs) Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app) Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze) Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal) Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

Role Overview:We’re looking for a Writer – Short-Form Content who understands digital-first storytelling and can create engaging scripts for short-form learning and edutainment videos. This role is focused on video scripting, storytelling, audience engagement, and content performance—not traditional article or blog writing.

Key Responsibilities:
● Write scripts for short-form learning, edutainment, and digital video content.

  • Develop strong hooks, narrative flow, information structure, pacing, and CTAs.
  • Simplify complex topics into clear, engaging, and conversational content.
  • Create content across Finance, Career, Business, English, AI, Social Media, and Government categories.
  • Develop episodic formats, content series, and recurring content properties.
  • Conduct research and fact-check information before scripting.
    •

. ● Adapt scripts based on audience insights, language, trends, and content performance.

  • Collaborate with creative and production teams to ensure scripts are production-friendly.
  • Use AI tools for research, ideation, drafting, and content refinement, while maintaining originality and accuracy.
  • Think from a performance perspective—creating content that makes viewers stop, watch, understand, and continue watching.

Requirements

  • Experience in short-form video writing, digital media, YouTube, Reels, edutainment, or creator-led content.
  • Strong understanding of hooks, retention, pacing, storytelling, and audience engagement.
  • Strong research, fact-checking, and information-simplification skills.
  • Ability to write conversational and engaging scripts rather than traditional articles/blogs.
  • Native or strong proficiency in Tamil Language.
  • Good understanding of how written scripts translate into visual/video storytelling.
  • Comfortable using AI tools for content research, ideation, and refinement.
  • Strong creative judgment, attention to detail, and ownership.

The Role

Our vision for Veeva OpenData is to become the global leader in reference data for the life sciences industry. The world's top pharma and biotech companies use our data as the foundational layer for their commercial and medical operations

This means the data products you build will directly accelerate getting life-saving treatments to patients. As a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC), we balance purpose with profit, operating with a culture of extreme autonomy, speed, and ownership.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial data professional to step into the Data Product Manager role in the OpenData Europe team. The role is fully remote in the UK, Germany, or Spain. Travel expected: 10%.

If you have a strong technical foundation in data analytics or engineering and are tired of just pulling data to fulfill tickets, this is your chance to own the roadmap. You won't just oversee data pipelines; you will lead product strategy, identify new market opportunities, and lead cross-functional execution from end to end.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Product Plan: Serve as the end-to-end owner for the designated product, actively scaling its customer footprint and driving product strategy.

  • Drive Customer Success: Partner directly with strategy, sales, and services teams to gather customer feedback, iterate rapidly, and ensure the product is continuously improving.
  • Champion Data Excellence: Set and enforce rigorous KPIs for data coverage, completeness, and accuracy, maximizing data quality.
  • Navigate Complex Markets: Stay ahead of healthcare regulations, compliance requirements, and market shifts, adapting the product roadmap to turn market complexity into a competitive advantage.

Requirements

  • Speed & Quality Focus: A detail-oriented professional who executes with speed and quality.
  • Experience: 2+ years of experience in data analytics or product management, with a proven track record of extracting value from complex datasets.
  • Ruthless Prioritization: Strong product intuition with the ability to manage a backlog, balancing long-term product scope, strict data quality standards, and customer feedback.
  • Technical Fluency: Proficient in SQL. You don't just rely on dashboards; you can query the database directly to investigate issues, validate data quality, and prototype solutions.
  • Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Management, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Communication: Fluent in English (C1 or higher), enabling you to effectively manage global stakeholders and translate complex technical concepts into business strategy.

Nice to Have

  • Life Sciences Expertise: Experience building data products specifically for the life sciences industry, spanning data sources, data modeling, sourcing, analysis, and delivery.

Overview

GCG Custom Engineered Solutions is currently seeking a Buyer to join the Custom Engineered Solutions procurement team!

As a Buyer with our procurement team, you will be responsible for planning and purchasing the raw materials needed to support our cable assembly operations. You’ll play a key role in ensuring materials are available to meet production demand while maintaining appropriate inventory levels, cost control, and supplier performance.

This role requires close coordination with internal teams and suppliers to manage demand signals, execute purchase orders, and maintain a steady flow of materials through the operation. Your work will directly support on-time delivery and overall operational efficiency.

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7:00am to 4:00pm EST

What You’ll Do

Procurement Execution & Order Management

  • Manage purchase orders from requisition through receipt, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with production requirements
  • Procure raw materials, MRO, and services at optimal cost, quality, and lead time
  • Monitor open orders and proactively manage delivery schedules to prevent shortages or disruptions

Material Planning & Inventory Management

  • Review MRP outputs in Oracle to plan and maintain appropriate inventory levels for assigned commodities
  • Establish and adjust safety stock levels in alignment with production needs and business objectives
  • Balance inventory investment with service level expectations to support efficient operations

Supplier Management & Sourcing

  • Source and evaluate suppliers, obtain quotations, and negotiate pricing and lead times
  • Build and maintain strong supplier relationships to support reliability and continuous improvement
  • Participate in supplier performance reviews and support corrective actions as needed

Operational & Cross-Functional Support

  • Partner with production, engineering, and supply chain teams to align material availability with manufacturing schedules
  • Resolve material issues including shortages, quality concerns, and supplier discrepancies
  • Support cost reduction initiatives and process improvements across the procurement function
  • Maintain accurate data and transaction integrity within ERP and procurement systems

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or related field preferred
  • 3–5 years of experience in a purchasing, buyer, or materials planning role within a manufacturing environment
  • Experience working with MRP/ERP systems (Oracle strongly preferred)
  • Strong understanding of material planning, inventory control, and procurement processes
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, production-driven environment
  • Effective communication and negotiation skills with both internal teams and external suppliers
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and standard business applications
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy, follow-through, and problem-solving

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary ranging from $60,000 to $65,000, dependent on relevant experience
  • Comprehensive health coverage with multiple plan options (CDHP and PPO)
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, supplemental insurance options
  • Generous time off including PTO, paid holidays, parental leave, and compassionate care leave
  • Wellness and support programs (EAP, wellness incentives, telehealth)
  • Extras including dental/vision, FSAs/HSAs with company contributions, pet insurance, legal services, and ID theft protection
  • An employee-centric culture that values and truly appreciates our most important asset: You!

Our Use of AI in Recruiting

At GCG, we use AI technology to assist with our interviews by automating note-taking, allowing our hiring teams to focus fully on the conversation. This technology supports efficiency and accuracy in capturing candidate insights during interviews but is not used to evaluate resumes. All resume reviews and candidate assessments are conducted directly by our corporate recruiting team and hiring managers to ensure a thoughtful, human-centered approach.

About Custom Engineered Solutions (CES)

GCG Custom Engineered Solutions delivers innovative wire and cable solutions, serving industries including renewable energy, data communications, industrial applications, irrigation, and more. We are committed to engineering excellence, customer-driven innovation, and high-quality products that help businesses solve complex challenges with tailored solutions. Built on a foundation of expertise, flexibility, and humility, we are dedicated to solving customer challenges, adapting to their needs, and continuously improving.

raw.description:
Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers’ systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations.

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists.

Key team values:

  • Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
  • Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
  • Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
  • Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay ahead

About the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365.

  • Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc.) for multi-tenant SaaS environments.

  • Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven).

  • Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles.

  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems.

  • Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability.

  • Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization.

  • Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization.

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built.

You will be successful in this role if you:

  • Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer.

  • Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture.

  • Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives.

  • Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers.

  • Are able to make data-driven decisions.

  • Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from.

  • Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push.

We are looking for:

  • 7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements.

  • 5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants.

  • Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices.

  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems.

  • Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns.

  • Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e).

Technical Skills and Experience:

  • Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc.).

  • Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling).

  • Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing.

  • Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs.

  • Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production.

  • Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms.

  • CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

  • OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking).

  • Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin).

What You’ll Get:

  • Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
  • Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes.
  • Career development and mentorship
  • A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heart

Please be advised that Jitterbit does not:

  • Conduct interviews through unsecure messaging platforms.
  • Request sensitive personal information, such as social security numbers or bank details, during initial contact.
  • Require payment or fees from applicants at any stage of the hiring process.
  • Offer unrealistic salaries or benefits packages.

Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently.

For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally.

raw.title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Belfast, United Kingdom
raw.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
raw.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Within Danaher the work our diagnostic businesses do saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.


You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.


We’re accelerating the development of cutting-edge diagnostics to solve some of the world’s most pressing health challenges. Across our diagnostics operating companies we are driving innovation through partnerships with top academic institutions and leading players in biopharma and translational research. We’re bringing the best minds together to accelerate innovation and unlock the full potential of the latest scientific advances. Together, we’re expanding access to precision diagnostics for millions of people worldwide - and we’re using our unmatched global scale and proven playbook to make it happen, from hospital labs to mobile clinics. By helping providers, patients, and families get faster, more precise diagnostic results, we’re improving treatment options and saving lives.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.


The Sr. Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA) is responsible for set-up, initiation, execution, monitoring and close-out of IVD and medical device clinical trials at external clinical research sites and/or laboratories. The Sr. CRA should be able to independently train and manage external clinical research sites.


This position reports to the Manager, Clinical Site Operations and is part of the Global Clinical Affairs organization. The position will be fully remote within the United States.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:


  • Oversee clinical study protocol execution at external sites, from start-up to close-out, ensuring timely data collection and compliance with FDA standards and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) 
  • Develop and maintain relationships with institutions, study investigators, internal stakeholders, and vendors to ensure successful trial execution, data integrity and adherence to project requirements 
  • Conduct independent study monitoring, including site coordination, investigational product accountability, and assessments of protocol deviations and/or adverse events, and drive clinical data quality which can include follow up on incomplete data entry and/or outstanding queries 
  • Manage IRB submissions and all study regulatory documentation to ensure Trial Master File is kept up to date and audit ready
  • Contribute to study planning including budget and contract negotiation and timeline forecasts, site identification and qualifications, and process improvement initiatives within the Global Clinical Affairs organization; as well as prepare study documents, including creating clinical templates, such as informed consent forms, clinical monitoring plan, etc.

The essential requirements of the job include:


  • Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years clinical research experience OR Master’s degree with 3+ years clinical research experience OR Doctoral degree in field with clinical research experience
  • Basic knowledge of regulatory requirements and Good Clinical Practice for in vitro diagnostic and medical device products 
  • Previous experience with managing clinical research sites and monitoring clinical study data
  • Good technical background to understand and communicate current and new technologies 
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously 

Travel Requirements:

raw.description:
Location: Germany, remote

Working Period: Permanent, Full-time

Reports to: Head of Business Development, Europe

Salary range: 60,000-65,000 Euro

Yugo is the trusted name for student housing, globally. Every day we connect young people to opportunities and students to amazing spaces. Here at Yugo, we like to do things differently. It's about people, planet, and passion.

As a Business Development Executive, you will be Yugo’s on-the-ground presence across continental Northern Europe (France, Austria, Germany and Poland), generating and nurturing leads, and supporting underwriting and tender processes with local market insight. You will act as a cultural and language reference point for the region, building relationships and representing Yugo in-market. Commercial structuring and negotiation for opportunities you generate is currently led by the Head of Business Development, Europe, to whom this role reports, while the team scales. This is a fantastic opportunity for an ambitious, culturally fluent self-starter to build a career in commercial business development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate new business leads across continental Northern Europe (France, Austria, Germany and Poland) through research, outreach and market mapping.
  • Act as Yugo’s on-the-ground presence in-market, building relationships with developers, agents and local stakeholders.
  • Serve as a cultural and language reference point for the region, helping the wider team navigate local nuance and relationships.
  • Qualify and nurture leads through the early stages of the pipeline, maintaining regular contact until opportunities are ready for commercial engagement.
  • Support underwriting of new opportunities with local market insight, site data and market comparables.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all deals, contacts, leads and company information in HubSpot, keeping the pipeline current and reliable for the wider team.
  • Conduct market and competitor research to identify new opportunities across the region.
  • Organise and support local meetings, site visits and introductions, building Yugo’s profile in-market.
  • Support tenders, RFP responses and proposal development with local market knowledge and language support.
  • Represent Yugo at industry events and networking opportunities as required, supporting lead generation and brand visibility.
  • Liaise with internal teams (operations, finance, legal) to support the smooth progression of opportunities from initial enquiry to handover.
  • Feed local market intelligence back to the Head of Business Development and wider team to inform commercial strategy.
  • Support post-deal handover to the operations team, helping ensure a smooth transition from signed agreement to mobilisation.
  • Monitor industry trends and market activity across the region to help identify new business opportunities.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Support the Head of Business Development in maintaining relationships with existing introducers, agents and partners across the region.
  • Help monitor and track the performance of live opportunities, flagging risks or delays to the wider team.
  • Assist with onboarding new opportunities into operational delivery once contracts are signed.
  • Support continuous improvement of business development processes, tools and reporting.
  • Build a strong working knowledge of Yugo’s existing continental European accounts to support the wider team where needed.

What else?

This job description serves as a guideline, this list of responsibilities is not intended to be exhaustive and other requests commensurate with the role may be made of you from time-to-time. This is a hands-on, fast-paced support role.

Requirements

  • Some experience in business development, sales, real estate or property management is beneficial; student accommodation or PBSA experience is a plus but not essential.
  • Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Confident communicator, comfortable engaging with prospective clients and internal stakeholders across different cultures and languages.
  • Confident in building, nurturing and progressing relationships, across both short-term and long-term deal generation.
  • Financially numerate, with an interest in developing commercial and underwriting skills.
  • Common sense in commercial negotiations.
  • A proactive self-starter, comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent in English plus at least one additional language relevant to the region (e.g. German, French or Polish) — genuine local and cultural fluency is central to this role.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (particularly Excel and PowerPoint) and comfortable learning CRM systems.
  • A genuine interest in the student housing / PBSA sector and a desire to build a career in commercial business development.
  • Willingness to travel regularly across continental Northern Europe.
  • An aptitude for AI as we continue to bring efficiencies to our business, freeing up more time to build relationships.

raw.title: Falcon MLR Strategy - EU
raw.excerpt: Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster.
raw.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

MLR review is one of the Life Science industry's biggest bottlenecks - and we're rebuilding it with AI.

Falcon MLR is Veeva's AI application for medical, legal, and regulatory (MLR) review. Our AI agents review promotional material the way expert reviewers do: against the actual rules of each market and the science behind the claims. We're looking for an MLR expert to take ownership of review quality across Europe.

You have sat in the review meetings. You know the codes, the process, and their pain points. Now, help build the reviewer and shape the future of MLR for the entire Life Science industry. You'll work directly with Falcon MLR's founding team, and your judgment will ship into a product used globally by the top Pharmaceutical companies.

We work like a start-up inside Veeva. The team is small, you own your area end to end, and your decisions reach the product fast. It suits people who like to build and take ownership.

Jobs that combine deep MLR expertise with frontier AI barely exist. This is one.

What You'll Do

  • Maximize reviewer agreement with Falcon's findings across our EU markets
  • Lead our regulatory monitoring system with engineering and product, and coordinate with other regions
  • Operationalize the reviewer-feedback loop, turning customer inputs into product improvements
  • Investigate, diagnose and resolve “why did Falcon flag this?” - read the agent's traces, find the root cause, fix it. Build the process for handling these questions with users
  • Automate recurring tasks with AI workflows
  • Ownership of quality benchmarks e.g. review quality, in cross functional collaboration with engineering and product

Requirements

  • You have been part of MLR/PRC review of promotional material - in pharma, biotech or at an agency serving one
  • You know the European codes - EFPIA, or national ones like ABPI, ENLI, FSA, Farmindustria, LEEM
  • You learn dense regulatory and legal material fast - and have results to show
  • AI is already part of your daily work – you have automated parts of your own job and want to go further
  • You have worked hands-on in Vault PromoMats - reviews, annotations, claims libraries
  • You live in the EU

Interviewing with Veeva

    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A personality assessment
    3. A practical case exercise
    4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

  • Paid Maternity & Paternity Leave
  • Global Mobile phone & Internet Policy
  • Veeva 1% Giving
  • Fitness Reimbursements
  • Veeva Break

Compensation

  • Total Compensation: 90,000 - 140,000 EUR
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

raw.title: Senior Mobile Engineer (React Native)
raw.excerpt: Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies.
raw.description:
Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies. We're handling petabyte-scale data with sub-second queries. Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.

Role

Build and evolve AirSpot, a mobile app that lets the public report drone sightings while giving law enforcement and defense teams the information they need to understand what's happening in the airspace around them.

You'll work across the full mobile surface: real-time geospatial data, reporting workflows, maps, alerts, feeds, and offline-capable experiences. The app is already under development with React Native and Expo; you'll join an early team, co-own the architecture, and help take it from an early product to a production-grade application used by real people.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role. You'll make architectural decisions, build features end to end, improve performance and reliability, and help establish the engineering practices that the mobile team will grow around.

What you'll do

  • Build and ship production mobile features with React Native, Expo, TypeScript, and Expo Router.
  • Own architectural decisions across state management, data fetching, offline behavior, navigation, and the mobile build/release pipeline.
  • Build geospatial experiences with MapLibre, including real-time location and map interactions.
  • Improve performance and reliability across startup time, animations, lists, memory, battery, and crashes.
  • Establish reliable testing with Jest, React Native Testing Library, and Maestro.
  • Own production delivery with EAS, including builds, signing, releases, and app store readiness.
  • Contribute to backend APIs when useful and help establish engineering standards as the team grows.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery without compromising quality.

About you

  • Several years of professional software engineering experience, includingat least two production React Native apps with real users.
  • Strong React Native, TypeScript, and Expo experience, including theNew Architecture(Fabric, TurboModules, Bridgeless).
  • Experience with mobile performance, testing, observability, and production releases.
  • Hands-on experience with MapLibre, Mapbox, Google Maps, or comparable mobile mapping technologies.
  • Evidence of owning architecture or major technical decisions, not just implementing predefined features.
  • Strong engineering judgment, pragmatic problem-solving, and the ability to work independently in a small team.
  • University-level technical education in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
  • Eligible to work in Germany and, where required, for EU/NATO security clearance.

Nice-to-haves

  • Node.js, Bun, or other backend experience.
  • Reanimated, Gesture Handler, and advanced React Native animations.
  • Geospatial, aviation, ADS-B, drone, or real-time location experience.
  • Experience with EAS/Fastlane and mobile CI/CD.
  • Defense, law enforcement, or other regulated-environment experience.
  • German language skills.
  • Open-source contributions to React Native or Expo.
  • Practical experience with AI coding agents and modern AI-assisted development.

What we offer

  • Own the mobile architecture:Shape a greenfield product and its technical direction.
  • Modern stack:React Native, Expo, New Architecture, Reanimated, MapLibre, TanStack Query, and Zustand.
  • High ownership:Work in a small team where your decisions have direct product impact.
  • Remote-first, Germany-wide: Work from wherever you do your best work, with regular team gatherings in Berlin/Dresden and other off-site locations.
  • Flexibility by default: Flexible working hours help you make work fit your life.
  • Your setup, your way: Get a personal home-office equipment budget to create a workspace that works for you.
  • 30 days of vacation: Take the time you need to recharge and come back with fresh energy.
  • Keep growing: We invest in your personal and professional development.
  • Get rewarded for impact: Performance bonuses are tied to agreed objectives and key results.
  • A warm welcome: Every new team member gets a welcome goodie bag.
  • Good people, good times: From summer and Christmas parties to regular team gatherings, we make time to celebrate together.
  • A mission that matters: Work on challenges with tangible impact on public safety and national security.

raw.excerpt: At VC3, we don’t just solve IT problems — we own them.
raw.description:
At VC3, we don’t just solve IT problems — we own them. We serve hundreds of municipalities and organizations across the United States and Canada, bringing IT to the people who need it most. We believe in earning trust, having a growth mindset, and delivering excellence every single time.

We're a team of doers, builders, and tech whisperers who live by 4 core values:
Go Beyond | Own It | Be Curious| Serve as One
We pride ourselves on making IT personal, making IT easy, and getting IT right. And it all starts with our talented team that is committed to raising the bar.
The Impact you will have:
You will be the primary point of contact, partnering closely with clients and internal teams to identify opportunities for solving business problems via standards alignment, expectation setting and implementation. You will work directly with the client team and VC3 technical teams to ensure smooth and successful delivery of technical services. You will manage day-to-day requests such as escalations, client meetings, and document preparation. You will ensure high client satisfaction by keeping informed on technology upgrade cycles, project schedules and future client needs.

What you will be doing:

  • Lead meetings with the client, to provide reports related to issue trending, ongoing/upcoming projects, system performance, change management, and potential technical improvements
  • Prepare and review reports and metrics utilizing internal tools to present and share with the client as requested
  • Measure client satisfaction, set and manage client expectations, discuss service agreements, and help manage client vendor relations
  • Identify client churn risks to develop solution strategies with internal teams and service resources
  • Advocate for the client in day-to-day operations, including support services, proactive maintenance, and procurement, work with internal teams to ensure client deadlines are met
  • Assist with change management processes for the client, document escalations, and participate in internal meetings for effective resolution
  • Participate in major incident response by coordinating resolution efforts, communicating effectively with stakeholders, assisting in post-incident reviews, and collaborating with internal and external teams to analyze operations and identify efficiency improvements
  • Collaborate with Strategic Advisors / vCIO to help develop the strategic plan for clients by assisting with agreement updates, as well as help with workstation replacement strategy and client’s planning and budget cycles
  • Maintain Knowledge of technology products and services applicable to the client base, including hardware, software and VC3 services
  • Assist with the onboarding and offboarding process for new clients and assist with client presentations and introductions to the VC3 way including meeting with clients at their office for check-ins and during onboarding process when necessary
  • Contribute to client documentation with accuracy and ensure data integrity
  • Ongoing participation in internal meetings such as huddles, L10s, training and company meetings
  • Utilize automated systems when applicable to manage agreement reconciliation to ensure accurate billing
  • Review and investigate invoices when necessary to ensure accuracy before approving - address invoice questions and concerns from clients.
  • Invoicing review and approval, including assisting clients with billing inquiries and working closely with the VC3 finance and collection teams
  • Additional duties as assigned

The tools you bring:

  • Proven ability in relationship building, data analysis, consultative selling and collaboration
  • Strong organizational, time management, presentation and customer service skills
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant technical experience preferred but not required
  • Degree or diploma in a related field preferred
  • Knowledge of ITIL standards is preferred
  • Experience with in-person and virtual client meetings required
  • Experience with municipal clients/leaders a strong asset
  • Go Beyond – you take that extra step to create moments that are unexpected but appreciated.
  • Own It - You have the courage to do what's right, the resolve to take responsibility, and the grit to cross the finish line.
  • Be Curious - You challenge the status quo and aim for continuous improvement and constant learning.
  • Serve as One - You believe that together, we are greater than the sum of our individuals, and that teamwork is essential to success.

What's in it for you:

  • Flexibility– We’re remote-first, but not remote-only. Some roles include an onsite component, depending on team needs. We aim to give you the flexibility to do your best work, plus company-paid time off to help you thrive in work and in life.
  • Well-being & Support - Caring for our team goes beyond the workday. We offer a range of benefits to support your overall well-being, from mental health and leave support through our Employee and Family Assistance Program, to financial wellness through company-matched 401(k)/RRSP plans. Whether it’s today’s needs or tomorrow’s goals, we’ve got you covered.
  • Grow with Us – Whether you’re just getting started or ready to take the next step, we are committed to investing in your growth. We offer structured development through our Leadership Academy, monthly learning sessions, mentorship programs, learning reimbursements, internal career fairs, job shadowing, and personalized career-pathing to support internal mobility.
  • People-First Culture – We live our values, support each other, and create a space where everyone belongs. We have a common goal of doing work that matters, with autonomy, recognition, and a mission to serve those who serve.
  • Transparent Leadership – From open communication to clear company goals, our leaders are involved, and our managers are here to support your growth every step of the way.
Applicant selected will be subject to a criminal and department of motor vehicles background checks and must meet Criminal Justice Information Systems (CJIS) requirements post-employment

Thank you for your interest in VC3. We appreciate all applications; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Learn more about VC3 by visiting our website and follow us on LinkedIn to stay informed!

At VC3, we don’t just solve IT problems — we own them. We serve hundreds of municipalities and organizations across the United States and Canada, bringing IT to the people who need it most. We believe in earning trust, having a growth mindset, and delivering excellence every single time.

We're a team of doers, builders, and tech whisperers who live by 4 core values:
Go Beyond | Own It | Be Curious| Serve as One
We pride ourselves on making IT personal, making IT easy, and getting IT right. And it all starts with our talented team that is committed to raising the bar.
The Impact you will have:
You will be the primary point of contact, partnering closely with clients and internal teams to identify opportunities for solving business problems via standards alignment, expectation setting and implementation. You will work directly with the client team and VC3 technical teams to ensure smooth and successful delivery of technical services. You will manage day-to-day requests such as escalations, client meetings, and document preparation. You will ensure high client satisfaction by keeping informed on technology upgrade cycles, project schedules and future client needs.

What you will be doing:

  • Lead meetings with the client, to provide reports related to issue trending, ongoing/upcoming projects, system performance, change management, and potential technical improvements
  • Prepare and review reports and metrics utilizing internal tools to present and share with the client as requested
  • Measure client satisfaction, set and manage client expectations, discuss service agreements, and help manage client vendor relations
  • Identify client churn risks to develop solution strategies with internal teams and service resources
  • Advocate for the client in day-to-day operations, including support services, proactive maintenance, and procurement, work with internal teams to ensure client deadlines are met
  • Assist with change management processes for the client, document escalations, and participate in internal meetings for effective resolution
  • Participate in major incident response by coordinating resolution efforts, communicating effectively with stakeholders, assisting in post-incident reviews, and collaborating with internal and external teams to analyze operations and identify efficiency improvements
  • Collaborate with Strategic Advisors / vCIO to help develop the strategic plan for clients by assisting with agreement updates, as well as help with workstation replacement strategy and client’s planning and budget cycles
  • Maintain Knowledge of technology products and services applicable to the client base, including hardware, software and VC3 services
  • Assist with the onboarding and offboarding process for new clients and assist with client presentations and introductions to the VC3 way including meeting with clients at their office for check-ins and during onboarding process when necessary
  • Contribute to client documentation with accuracy and ensure data integrity
  • Ongoing participation in internal meetings such as huddles, L10s, training and company meetings
  • Utilize automated systems when applicable to manage agreement reconciliation to ensure accurate billing
  • Review and investigate invoices when necessary to ensure accuracy before approving - address invoice questions and concerns from clients.
  • Invoicing review and approval, including assisting clients with billing inquiries and working closely with the VC3 finance and collection teams
  • Additional duties as assigned

The tools you bring:

  • Proven ability in relationship building, data analysis, consultative selling and collaboration
  • Strong organizational, time management, presentation and customer service skills
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant technical experience preferred but not required
  • Degree or diploma in a related field preferred
  • Knowledge of ITIL standards is preferred
  • Experience with in-person and virtual client meetings required
  • Experience with municipal clients/leaders a strong asset
  • Go Beyond – you take that extra step to create moments that are unexpected but appreciated.
  • Own It - You have the courage to do what's right, the resolve to take responsibility, and the grit to cross the finish line.
  • Be Curious - You challenge the status quo and aim for continuous improvement and constant learning.
  • Serve as One - You believe that together, we are greater than the sum of our individuals, and that teamwork is essential to success.

What's in it for you:

  • Flexibility– We’re remote-first, but not remote-only. Some roles include an onsite component, depending on team needs. We aim to give you the flexibility to do your best work, plus company-paid time off to help you thrive in work and in life.
  • Well-being & Support - Caring for our team goes beyond the workday. We offer a range of benefits to support your overall well-being, from mental health and leave support through our Employee and Family Assistance Program, to financial wellness through company-matched 401(k)/RRSP plans. Whether it’s today’s needs or tomorrow’s goals, we’ve got you covered.
  • Grow with Us – Whether you’re just getting started or ready to take the next step, we are committed to investing in your growth. We offer structured development through our Leadership Academy, monthly learning sessions, mentorship programs, learning reimbursements, internal career fairs, job shadowing, and personalized career-pathing to support internal mobility.
  • People-First Culture – We live our values, support each other, and create a space where everyone belongs. We have a common goal of doing work that matters, with autonomy, recognition, and a mission to serve those who serve.
  • Transparent Leadership – From open communication to clear company goals, our leaders are involved, and our managers are here to support your growth every step of the way.
Applicant selected will be subject to a criminal and department of motor vehicles background checks and must meet Criminal Justice Information Systems (CJIS) requirements post-employment

Thank you for your interest in VC3. We appreciate all applications; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Learn more about VC3 by visiting our website and follow us on LinkedIn to stay informed!

raw.description:
Role Title: Senior Mobile Software Engineer

Role Type: Contractor (~15 hrs a week)

Location: Remote

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

As an expert, you will create Reinforcement Learning Environments that test an AI model’s ability to solve complex mobile software engineering problems related to fixing code, creating features, refactoring code, and optimizing performance. You will be tasked with creating a reproducible environment and a golden reference solution for each problem.

Scope of Work

  1. Create realistic, interesting, and extremely challenging mobile coding tasks for frontier AI models using your preferred repositories.
  2. Design problems that require strong mobile engineering skills, such as tracking down subtle bugs, building non-trivial features, handling application state and lifecycle, or improving performance.
  3. Develop tasks relevant to your expertise: cross-platform applications using TypeScript, JavaScript, or Dart; iOS applications using Swift; or Android applications using Kotlin.
  4. For each task, define the problem, build a reproducible environment, and write deterministic verifiers that accept correct solutions across different valid implementations while rejecting incorrect, incomplete, or hard-coded approaches.
  5. Provide a reference solution showing how the task can be solved.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Significant hands-on expertise in at least one of the following mobile development tracks:
  2. Cross-platform: TypeScript or JavaScript with React Native, or Dart with Flutter.
  3. iOS: Swift with SwiftUI or UIKit.
  4. Android: Kotlin with Jetpack Compose or the Android View system.
  5. Deep understanding of mobile application architecture, state management, asynchronous programming, and application lifecycle.
  6. Proven ability to debug complex mobile applications, resolve bugs, and deliver effective performance improvements.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum weekly submission requirements apply and will be communicated during onboarding.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.
