raw.description:
Job Description

This position is a fully remote role and requires working hours in EST or CST. An active and clear RN and APRN or Physician Assistant license in GA, PA, and/or OH is required at time of hire.

A bit about this role:

The Gold Care Program is a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary team of physicians, advanced practice providers, nurse case managers, social work case managers, community health workers, and scheduling team, united by our mission to build a better care delivery system for Devoted’s most complex members. We provide whole-person clinical, social and logistical support for patients with complex chronic conditions, frail elders, and patients at high risk of hospital admissions.

The Advanced Practice Provider (APP) role on the Gold Care team is to reinforce and adjust the patient’s plan of care according to what matters most to the patient, their clinical picture, and in response to any barriers or obstacles they are facing. They manage the clinical trajectory of the patient including symptom management, chronic disease management, and adjustments to the clinical plan. The NP’s clinical decision making and bias-to-action ensures we continuously deliver on meeting patients’ needs as determined by both the interdisciplinary team and by the patient’s priorities.

Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Deliver exceptional care to a cohort of complex patients across multiple geographies, leveraging video telehealth visits and an interdisciplinary team.

  • Guide and oversee the medical management of patients (utilizing the 5M framework) during their tenure with Gold Care.

  • Work closely with other members of the patient's care team including their PCP, specialists, and other Devoted teams such as pharmacy, or specialty care. You will also collaborate with the patients’ support systems such as family members and caregivers in order to coordinate care for the patient and deliver a collaborative care plan.

  • For patients in Gold Care, perform comprehensive assessment visits, provide post-acute transition support, comprehensive diagnosis/disease review, medication review, and assessment for quality of care (Stars/Hedis) interventions as well as social and home health/DME needs.

  • In infrequent instances when appropriate and compliant with NP licensure, you may also provide telehealth visits to members outside of your panel to support other Devoted Medical service lines

  • As the program continues to grow, there may be an infrequent weekend on-call component to support our clinical nurses who triage calls from our members during the weekend.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient medical records, ensuring compliance with relevant legal and ethical guidelines.

  • Adhere to all relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards, including patient privacy and telehealth regulations.

Required skills and experience:

  • An active and clear RN and APRN or Physician Assistant license in GA, PA, and/or OH is required at time of hire and must be maintained while employed at Devoted Medical with a willingness to obtain and maintain multiple state licenses

  • Three or more years working as an APP with experience in primary care, house calls, internal medicine, family medicine, geriatrics, and/or palliative care

  • Proficiency in using telehealth technology and electronic health records (EHR)

  • Active BLS at time of hire and must maintain while employed at Devoted Medical

Desired skills and experience:

  • Virtual care experience is preferred with a strong desire to continue practicing clinical nursing and perform virtual visits - you believe in the mission of bringing care to where the patient lives

  • Experience providing clinical care in collaboration with interdisciplinary teams is preferred

  • Experience working with complex, frail, or vulnerable populations, including in Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) setting

  • Team player, continuous improvement mentality and can-do attitude

  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-energy organization

  • Ability to adapt quickly and maintain flexibility with new workflows

  • Proficiency in English and Spanish preferred for this position, but not required

Salary Range: $120K-155K base range plus performance based bonus paid out quarterly or annually ($10K-$20K) for a total comp range of $130K-170K

Employer-sponsored health insurance and dental and vision plan with low or no premium

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Healthcare equality is at the center of Devoted’s mission to treat our members like family. We are committed to a diverse and vibrant workforce.

At Devoted Health, we’re on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for every person like family. That’s why we’re gathering smart, diverse, and big-hearted people to create a new kind of all-in-one healthcare company — one that combines compassion, health insurance, clinical care, service, and technology-to deliver a complete and integrated healthcare solution that delivers high quality care that everyone would want for someone they love. Founded in 2017, we've grown fast and now serve members across the United States. And we've just started. So join us on this mission!

Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

MKS2 Technologies, LLC, an award-winning high growth small business, creates innovative and customer-centric technology solutions in the areas of Cyber Security, Instructional Design and Training, Software Engineering and IT Support Services to improve the security and well-being of our clients. Our commitment to excellence and our “Mission First” orientation has resulted in steady growth and an expanding client base across government agencies. We have employees nationwide and for the past three consecutive years were named one of the fastest growing Veteran-owned companies in the nation. Please take a moment to browse through our website and learn more about what it means to serve with MKS2.

Position Summary:

The Contracts Manager will as the primary liaison between MKS2 and its customers for all contractual matters. This position manages the full lifecycle of government and commercial contracts, ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations, policies, and customer requirements. The ideal candidate will bring demonstrated experience in federal contracting and a strong understanding of U.S. government acquisition processes, particularly with the DoD, VA, commercial and federal government-related programs. The Contracts Manager will be a highly organized and detail-oriented member of the operations team.

Key Responsibilities:

Contract Lifecycle Management:

  • Provide cradle-to-grave support for various contract types (CPFF, FFP, T&M).
  • Draft, negotiate, execute, and administer contracts, subcontracts, NDAs, teaming agreements, MSAs, and B2Bs.
  • Manage contract modifications, extensions, and closeouts.
  • Oversee and maintain company registrations, NAICS codes, and representations and certifications.

Compliance & Risk Management:

  • Perform pre and post award contract reviews to ensure FAR, DFARS, and agency-specific compliance.

Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Serve as the point of contact for internal teams, customers, and partners on all contractual issues.
  • Collaborate with program managers, legal, business development and finance teams during proposal, negotiation, and execution phases.
  • Maintain strong customer relationships to support satisfaction and long-term success.

System & Process Oversight:

  • Maintain accurate records in contract and financial systems.
  • Maintain vendor portals.

Business Development & Proposal Support:

  • Support proposal development with contract compliance insights.
  • Perform opportunity and pipeline reviews in coordination with the Business Development Team.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Legal Studies, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5- 8 years of experience in contract management.
  • Deep knowledge of federal acquisition regulations (FAR/DFARS).
  • Strong negotiation, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency using all Microsoft Office 365 applications.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM) or equivalent.
  • Military service or work experience within the Federal Government a plus.
  • In-depth understanding of GSA schedules, Government-wide Acquisition Contracts, and IDIQ contract vehicles and their respective portals.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Occasional travel may be required.

Location: Remote

Salary: $95,000-$110,000

Benefits: MKS2 provides a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, 11 paid holidays, tuition/certification reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and additional voluntary benefit options. Benefits are available to eligible full-time employees.

Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: MKS2 Technologies is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Tufin is the leader in Network Security Policy Orchestration for enterprise cybersecurity. Our customers turn to Tufin to simplify management of some of the largest, most complex networks in the world, consisting of thousands of firewall and network devices and emerging hybrid cloud infrastructures. Enterprises select the company’s award-winning Tufin Orchestration Suite to increase agility in the face of ever-changing business demands while maintaining a robust security posture. The Suite reduces the attack surface and meets the need for greater visibility into secure and reliable application connectivity. Its network security automation enables enterprises to implement changes in minutes with proactive risk analysis and continuous policy compliance.

Responsibilities

  • Meet or exceed quarterly and yearly products/services sales goals.
  • Provide extensive tactical and strategic pre-sales support for the Tufin inside sales team.
  • Identify and develop business opportunities with potential customers/channels/partner.
  • Provide technical pre-sales support to various entities for the purpose of promoting and selling Tufin products/ services. Entities include: potential customers, existing customers, partners, and resellers. Pre-sales activities will also include close interaction with internal groups such as product management, marketing, R&D and post-sales support.
  • Initiate and manage numerous remote proof of concept installations.
  • Training partners and resellers on the proper positioning and technical sales of Tufin products.
  • Interfacing with R&D & Product Management for the purpose of articulating collected RFEs and the associated business cases
  • Ongoing collection and dissemination of technical competitive information
  • Execute responsibilities using all possible media and methods including conference calls, emails, web demonstrations, on site visits, public presentations, trade show attendance and more.

Requirements

Experience

  • Presales Expirience, either in another vendor or delivery partner environment
  • 2-5 years experience in networking and security
  • Ability to work in a team sales environment, participating in sales strategies as well as individual stand-alone sales activities.
  • Ability to understand the highly charged sales situations and hidden agendas
  • Highly developed interpersonal skill
  • Strong presentation and pitch skills
  • Ability to rapidly understand and articulate new technology.
  • A high sense of urgency and deep interest in serving the customer.

Skills

  • ﻿Hands on functional experience with multiple firewalls platforms to include some of the following:
  • Check Point Firewall-1, Provider-1, and VSX
  • Cisco FWSM, CSM, ASA, routers and switches
  • Juniper Firewalls and NSM
  • Fortinet Fortigate

About the role

Military.com is lookingfor a Field Content Creator with prior military service to bring real stories from the military community to our social channels. You will be comfortable in front of the camera and confident behind it, taking content from an initial idea through filming, interviewing, scripting, and editing.
This is a hands-on creator role for someone who understands military life and can connect naturally with service members, veterans, and military families. You will create engaging, accurate videos that help our audience feel informed, represented, and connected.

What you will do

  • Pitch original stories and recurring video ideas rooted in military life, veteran experiences, military culture, careers, and community events.
  • Host videos on camera, conduct interviews, and record clear voiceovers. Be comfortable speaking naturally, asking follow-up questions, and working from a script when needed.
  • Film in the field at approved events and locations, capturing interviews, supporting footage, and behind-the-scenes moments with a phone or camera.
  • Own the edit from raw footage to finished video, including strong opening hooks, pacing, captions, audio cleanup, basic color correction, and graphics.
  • Create vertical videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook, adapting each edit to the platform and audience.
  • Collaborate with the Social Media Manager and editorial and video teams on briefs, story accuracy, shoot plans, deadlines, and feedback.
  • Arrange interviews and shoot logistics, secure required filming permissions and participant releases, and follow editorial guidance on sensitive topics and military information.
  • Deliver organized footage and finished assets on schedule, make agreed revisions, and use performance feedback to improve future content.

Required qualifications

  • Prior military service is required. Candidates must bring firsthand experience of military life and a strong understanding of the U.S. military community.
  • Confident, engaging on-camera presence and the ability to build rapport with interview subjects from different backgrounds.
  • A portfolio showing video content you have filmed and edited, including examples of you speaking on camera.
  • Proficiency in a video editing tool such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut, with the ability to deliver polished social videos independently.
  • Practical filming skills, including framing, lighting, and capturing clean audio in changing field conditions.
  • Strong storytelling, interviewing, and writing skills, with sound judgment about accuracy, context, and respectful representation.
  • Ability to manage assignments independently, communicate reliably, meet agreed deadlines, and attend shoots at agreed locations.

Nice to have

  • Experience in military public affairs, journalism, documentary production, or event coverage.
  • Connections within military and veteran communities and experience finding compelling interview subjects.
  • Experience building recurring social video series, using audience insights, or producing clearly disclosed partner content.

Contract scope

This is a contract opportunity with on-location content assignments. Deliverable volume, turnaround times, revision rounds, contract duration, compensation, travel arrangements, and equipment needs will be agreed before work begins. Projects may include event coverage, interviews, explainers, and recurring video series.

What to include in your application

Please submit your resume or a brief summary of your military and content creation experience, plus three to five relevant video samples. Include at least one on-camera example and one video you filmed and edited yourself, identifying your role in each. Share your location, availability, travel capacity, editing tools, available equipment, and contract rates.

Job Description:

Quality Lead

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact as a Quality Lead. GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. At GDIT, people are our differentiators—you will help ensure that today is safe and tomorrow is smarter. Our work depends on a Quality Lead joining our team to support our client’s mission.

This role drives organizational excellence by leading quality planning, compliance, continuous improvement, and QA inspection processes that ensure performance objectives are met while proactively resolving issues and enhancing safety and communication across stakeholders.

Responsibilities


  • Own, maintain, and update the Quality Management Plan (QMP), ensuring all processes, procedures, and regulatory requirements remain current, compliant, and fully implemented.
  • Provide leadership to a small quality team (approximately 10–15 people), offering guidance, mentorship, and accountability for quality outcomes.
  • Work closely with project managers, stakeholders, Government technical staff, and customers to define requirements, identify risks, and determine appropriate resolution actions.
  • Deliver clear and concise written and verbal communication, including quality reports, status updates, inspection findings, and senior‑level briefings.

  • Champion continuous improvement initiatives and frameworks to reduce costs, optimize schedules, and enhance organizational performance.
  • Promote special safety precautions, lead safety-related briefings, and support communication across senior management, safety teams, and contractor personnel.
  • Collaborate with 5G/IT program staff; while deep IT expertise is not required, candidates should possess basic to moderate IT program knowledge and be comfortable integrating quality processes into technical environments.

Required Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of related experience with a strong focus on Quality Management Plan ownership and quality program execution.
  • Demonstrated experience leading small teams in a quality or operational environment.
  • Direct experience with QA inspection processes, quality assessments, test analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Join Our Team!

Sunbelt Rentals strives to be the customer's first choice in the equipment rental industry. From pumps to scaffolding to general construction tools, we aim to be the only call needed to outfit a job site with the proper equipment. Not only do we offer a vast fleet that ranks among the best in the industry, we pair it all with a friendly and knowledgeable staff. Our employees are our greatest asset, and although we present a comprehensive equipment offering, our expertise and service are what truly distinguish us from the competition.

We pride ourselves on investing in our workforce and offer competitive benefits, as well as extensive on-the-job training for all eligible employees.

As a highly successful national company, we are constantly looking for talented individuals to support our growth. If you are interested in pursuing a rewarding career, we invite you to review our opportunities!

Job Description Summary

Position Responsibilities:

  • May have oversight and support of Project Safety Coordinators
  • The position is remote based and will require travel based to provide project and event safety oversight and validation of company SH&E standards are successfully implemented across the US. Candidates should expect position l 75% overnight travel and potentially weekend travel.
  • Preparing reports and recommending procedures to improve organizational performance
  • Overseeing the overall integrity and quality of all Sunbelt Rentals safety protocols at individual branches within their assigned geographical area
  • Conducts branch and project safety compliance inspections and audits in accordance with scheduled program utilizing dedicated audit criteria including employee training, facility regulatory compliance, vehicle fleet / DOT compliance, shop and equipment rental fleet compliance.
  • Works with Branch Managers (BMs)to assign the correct Safety Coordinator to the location.
  • Provides training and guidance to Safety Coordinators in each branch to ensure a consistent approach is taken regarding policies and procedures.
  • Identifies deficiencies found during inspections; provides written evaluation of inspection with corrective action requirements utilizing Enablon; assists Branch Managers in mandating time period for completion of corrective actions and follows corrective actions until closure.
  • Responsible for delivering safety training modules to employees on an ongoing basis.
  • Assists Safety Coordinator as necessary with completion of required training, safety meeting coordination and completion, and maintenance of Safety Training & Documentation Manual.
  • Responsible for tracking and trending in their respected areas to identify which locations are adhering to the Sunbelt Rentals Leading Indicator Program and which areas need attention due an increase in lagging data.
  • Responsible for working with the Safety Director and Line of Business VP/leadership to develop an annual strategic SH&E Business Plan addressing prior year performance of the Region as well as annual targets for the Calendar and Fiscal Year.
  • Leads monthly Safety Coordinator Phone Call for all Coordinators in the region.
  • Train and monitor staff on Sunbelt Rentals Safety Tools.
  • Supports Branch Manager and Safety Coordinator in the investigation of all incidents and appropriate near-misses while assisting the BM in completion of reporting requirements and follows up as necessary to support the claims managers.
  • undefined

Requirements:

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Safety and Health or a related field or equivalent work experience plus a minimum of 7 years working with Safety, Health and Environmental Management Systems and implementation of safety programs
  • Preferred Safety Certification - CSP, ASP and CIH
  • Ability and willingness to travel 75%; overnight travel required, with potential weekend travel
  • Must live near or have easy access to a major airport hub. The coverage area will be the entire US.
  • Event and/or large construction project experience is a plus
  • Exceptional written and verbal skills when addressing either individuals or groups
  • Exceptional organizational skills
  • Ability to present information in classroom or conference call setting.
  • Ability to develop and execute a strategic plan that includes measurable goals based on leading and lagging indicator performance.
  • An observable positive attitude
  • Ability to track and trend performance of multiple locations based on incident data obtained through internal tracking mechanisms.
  • Dependable, motivated, and self-starter
  • Ability to multi-task and be highly organized
  • Customer-service oriented
  • A general overview of OSHA construction and general industry regulation knowledge
  • Working knowledge of DOT regulations and transportation safety
  • An ability to foster credibility with branch Supervisors, Safety Coordinators, and BMs
  • Proficiency with Excel, Word, Outlook and PowerPoint

Physical Demands:

Must be able to bend, squat, crouch and/or reach and lift up to 25 pounds or more, as required by the job. Some Sunbelt jobs may require driving for long periods of time, loading and unloading heavy equipment, performing work in extreme weather conditions including rain, wind or excessive temperatures and/or night and weekend work. All duties must be performed according to Sunbelt’s safety policies and guidelines.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to comply with ADA/ADAAA.

description: Media buying has changed. In 2026, a great media buyer is not just a button pusher.

raw.title: Media Buyer / Creative Strategist
raw.excerpt: Media buying has changed. In 2026, a great media buyer is not just a button pusher.
raw.description:
Media buying has changed.

In 2026, a great media buyer is not just a button pusher. They understand the full system: creative, offer, conversion rate, platform dynamics, competition, and what to test next.

At Sweat Pants Agency, we are hiring a performance media buyer who can drive growth across Meta ads for DTC and ecommerce brands.

This role is for someone who can run paid media and also think like a marketer.

You will build testing roadmaps, guide creative strategy, communicate with clients, and help us scale what works.

If you've built or scaled your own eCommerce brand, we want to hear from you.

If you love following SOPs and repeating the same campaign structure forever, this is not the job.

If you love thinking, testing, and building frameworks that win, keep reading.

Requirements

What You'll Do

  • Own paid media strategy for DTC/eCommerce clients across Meta and TikTok
  • Build creative testing roadmaps — develop angles, write briefs for editors, analyze what's working
  • Manage ad budgets ranging from $30k / mo to $1m / mo per client
  • Diagnose the full funnel — spot whether issues are creative, offer, or conversion
  • Communicate clearly with clients — present results, plans, and next steps
  • Work with UGC creators — source talent, write scripts, direct content when needed

You're A Great Fit If...

You have hands-on experience scaling eCommerce brands:

  • You've managed Meta Ads with real spend and can show results (CPA, ROAS, revenue)
  • Bonus: You've built/operated your own Shopify store or eComm brand

You understand creative is the lever:

  • You can pull insights from reviews, competitor ads, and comments to generate new angles
  • You've written UGC scripts or creative briefs
  • You can work with editors to create winning ad variations
  • Video editing or design skills are a plus

You're a strategist, not a robot:

  • You challenge assumptions and adapt fast
  • You don't blindly follow "best practices"
  • You can explain what you're doing and why

You have ownership and urgency:

  • You act like it's your money
  • You move fast and follow through
  • You don't wait to be told what to do

Benefits

Why This Role Is Exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You will be surrounded by people who move fast, care a lot, and take the work seriously.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

    - Marketing ops QA.** Be the person who catches it before the lead does. Build monitoring so breaks get caught in hours, not weeks: forms, Zapier and native integrations, automations, booking calendars, and tracking. Our form-to-CRM zaps have broken silently before. Under you, that doesn't happen twice. You'll also review campaign work before it ships, ads, copy, landing pages, and emails, against our brand and our goals, and flag early when something's off.

Track what's owed, chase status from people who don't report to you, and flag misses to marketing leadership early. raw.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Paid Media & Tracking Assistant to support our digital advertising, analytics, and tracking efforts across multiple paid media platforms. The ideal candidate has practical experience setting up, maintaining, and troubleshooting advertising pixels, events, conversion tracking, and analytics systems, with a strong understanding of how paid traffic is measured and optimized.

You will work closely with the marketing team to ensure that campaigns are properly tracked, conversions are accurately recorded, and our tracking infrastructure provides reliable data for reporting and optimization. This role is particularly suited to someone who enjoys working directly with ad platforms, analytics tools, event tracking, and campaign data rather than focusing solely on strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set up, manage, and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

  • Support paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

  • Define and maintain a clear event tracking structure, including event names, parameters, properties, and conversion definitions.

  • Implement and validate pixels, events, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and other tracking solutions across websites and campaigns.

  • Work with the tracking stack, including PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Events Manager, Brevo, and Microsoft Clarity.

  • Monitor tracking performance and investigate discrepancies between advertising platforms, analytics tools, and website data.

  • Debug tracking issues and identify why an event or conversion is not firing correctly, rather than only setting up campaigns.

  • Test and validate events across different platforms to ensure that data is being captured accurately and consistently.

  • Ensure that key events and conversions are properly defined, recorded, and attributed across the relevant platforms.

  • Assist with campaign setup, audience tracking, retargeting, and conversion measurement.

  • Analyze campaign and tracking data to identify potential issues and opportunities for improvement.

  • Work with websites, landing pages, and analytics tools to ensure proper data collection and attribution.

  • Help maintain organized tracking documentation and ensure that event naming and tracking structures remain consistent.

  • Stay up to date with changes to advertising platforms, tracking technologies, attribution, and privacy requirements.

  • Support testing and troubleshooting of new tracking setups before campaigns go live.

Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

  • Experience with TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

  • Practical experience with PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Microsoft Clarity, and Brevo.

  • Strong understanding of event tracking concepts, including event names, parameters, properties, conversion definitions, and attribution.

  • Experience troubleshooting tracking issues and identifying why events or conversions may not be firing, recording, or attributing correctly.

  • Familiarity with server-side tracking / Conversions API is a strong plus.

  • Experience with newer or emerging advertising platforms, including ChatGPT Ads, would be a significant advantage.

  • Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, dashboards, and campaign performance reports.

  • Strong attention to detail and a hands-on, problem-solving mindset.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is practical, detail-oriented, and technically curious. You should be comfortable getting into the actual ad platforms and tracking tools, testing events yourself, investigating discrepancies, and figuring out why something is not working as expected.

The ideal candidate should be able to go beyond simply setting up campaigns or implementing pixels. They should understand how the entire tracking flow works, from defining an event and its parameters to ensuring that it fires correctly, is captured by the relevant analytics tools, and is ultimately reflected as a meaningful conversion.

You do not need to be an advanced developer, but you should be confident working with tracking tools, advertising platforms, basic website elements, and analytics systems. Experience working across multiple paid media channels and the ability to quickly learn and troubleshoot new platforms are highly valued.

raw.description:
Who You Are:

You combine deep technical domain expertise with a strong focus on customer outcomes, defining what gets built, why it matters, and how it improves the decisions customers make every day. You bring highly structured thinking, a customer-obsessed mindset, strong written communication, and the technical depth to lead meaningful conversations with engineering, executive, and customer stakeholders alike.

Invicti is looking for a Principal Technical Product Manager to own our Code & Developer Security product area - spanning SAST, SCA, IaC, Container Security, and Secrets Detection. This is a high-ownership, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to build products that security and engineering teams actually trust: better signal, less noise, faster fixes. These products will be a significant part of the Invicti AppSec Platform.

What You’ll Be Doing:

AI is changing how software gets written, and it's changing this product area faster than almost any other. Development teams using AI coding assistants are shipping more code, faster, with less visibility into what's in it. That means larger attack surfaces, more opaque dependency chains, more auto-generated IaC, and secrets in places no one reviewed. The tools that win in this environment won't just scan more, they'll surface what actually matters, with enough context that a developer can act on it without filing a ticket.

At the same time, Invicti's portfolio is expanding. Our recently delivered ASPM platform creates a correlation layer above individual scan results. Octo, our agentic offensive security capability, is beginning to close the loop between static findings and validated exploitability. The Code Security product area sits at the foundation of this stack, and this PM will shape how those connections get built.

What You'll Own:

  • Full product ownership for the Code Security product area, SAST, SCA, IaC, Container Security, and Secrets Detection, across the Invicti and Acunetix product lines
  • Roadmap definition and prioritization grounded in customer evidence, market data, and portfolio strategy.
  • A point of view on how AI-assisted development changes the threat model, and how our scanning, triage, and remediation capabilities need to evolve in response
  • Positioning in a highly competitive market that includes incumbents and a growing set of AI-native entrants rethinking what static analysis can do

Requirements

What You'll Need:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a technical PM role at a security, developer tools, or infrastructure company desired
  • Familiarity with at least two of the core domains: SAST, SCA, IaC security, container security, or secrets management
  • A perspective on how AI-assisted development changes the security problem
  • Strong written communication
  • Experience working in a multi-product environment where roadmap decisions require cross-portfolio thinking
  • The ability to move with conviction under ambiguity, and the seniority to bring others along through influence
  • Strong ability to use current AI tools to improve the product development lifecycle.
  • Added Bonus:
  • Prior experience at a SAST, SCA, or software supply chain security vendor
  • Exposure to ASPM platforms or consolidated security findings workflows
  • Background shipping developer-facing products or integrations into CI/CD pipelines

Benefits

Who We Are:

Invicti Security helps more than 4,000 organizations worldwide secure web applications and APIs with the industry’s most accurate application security platform, powered by 20 years of technology leadership in DAST. Combining proof-based testing, runtime intelligence, and continuous innovation, Invicti enables AppSec teams to identify real risk, reduce alert noise, and ship secure software faster.

Invicti's proof-based philosophy, validate what's actually exploitable before surfacing it, sets a high bar for signal quality. Code Security is where that philosophy needs to extend upstream, into a world where AI is generating more code than any team can manually review. The PM who defines that product direction, at this moment, is doing genuinely consequential work.

Why Invicti:

Your Health & Wellness Matters:

  • Health Insurance: Taking care of our team goes beyond the office. We cover 100% of employee health care, vision and dental premium costs. For dependents, we contribute 75% of the health care and 50% vision/dental premium cost, so you can be sure that you and your family are in the best possible health. Coverage is effective your first day.
  • Employee Assistance Program: Emotional Support Counseling services - 24/7 Life Coaching, Dependent Care, Elder Care, Financial & Legal Support, Wellness Coaching, New Parent Support and more
  • Parental Leave: 16 week paid leave for birthing parent recovery. 4 week paid leave for non-birthing/bonding parent
  • 401(k) Savings Plan: 50% up to 6% company match with 100% annual cliff vesting

We Value Adult/Life Balance:

  • Hybrid Working Schedule: a hybrid/home schedule
  • Discretionary Time Off: Enjoy a flexible vacation schedule where you do not have to wait to use time off until it is accrued
  • Quarterly Thrive-Wellness Days: One extra vacation day per quarter where the entire company takes a break from normal, daily activities to refresh and rejuvenate
  • Volunteering: 5 days of paid time off each year to participate in the volunteer activities of your choice

We Value You:

  • Employee Recognition: Ongoing recognition & rewards. A Culture that emphasizes personal and professional growth

At Invicti, we embrace diversity and individuality in all forms. Discrimination has no place here - regardless of race, religion, gender, age, ability, sexual orientation, or any other aspect that makes you, you. We're all about creating a space where everyone feels valued and included. So come as you are and join us in shaping the future of our industry.

raw.description:
With 150+ locations in 17 states, QualDerm Partners is the largest multi-state female-founded and owned dermatology network in the U.S. At QualDerm Partners, we are united in our purpose: to educate, protect, and care for your skin. We are committed to bringing you the very best in comprehensive skin care so that you can achieve a confident, healthier, and more beautiful you!

Our mission is to educate communities and healthcare professionals about the importance of skin health; including skin cancer prevention, risk factors and how to achieve healthy skin through annual skin exams and dermatologic care. We strive to provide the latest proven, proactive and comprehensive dermatologic care to populations in the expanding geographies we serve by making high-quality skin care timelier and more accessible all while creating a rewarding work environment for our providers and employees.

Position Summary

This position works with a professional team of physicians and other staff who are trained in the medical and surgical specialty of dermatology with the purpose to be patient focused with the objective of delivering superior patient care and ensuring a positive patient experience and outcome. The Accounts Receivable Specialist is responsible for all day-to-day billing, claims issues, denials and follow-up for their assigned region/locations. Position proactively researches, identifies, and rectifies any circumstance affecting delayed submission or payment of accounts. Position communicates accounts receivable issues proactively to management to ensure compliance and accuracy. Position performs various administrative and clerical duties needed to support revenue cycle functions as needed. Position reports to the Manager, Accounts Receivable and/or Senior Director, Credentialing and Revenue Cycle.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Ability to identify the cause of claim denials and resolve them, with minimal assistance.
  • Analyze problems and report trends related to denials and payer trends.
  • Follow up on unpaid claims within standard billing cycle timeframe.
  • Prepare and submit corrected/replacement claims, reconsiderations, appeals, medical documentation and other necessary documents to payers via fax, provider portals, etc.
  • Make outbound calls to payers to resolve claims and payment issues.
  • Ensure the patient’s medical information is accurate and up to date.
  • Meets productivity requirements as established by organization and external benchmarks.
  • Provides necessary reporting and communication of any accounts receivable issues directly
  • to the team lead.
  • Effectively uses billing system to document patient accounts using proper grammar, spelling, and syntax.
  • Provide team lead with administrative assistance when needed including assisting with internal/external audits.
  • Maintains current knowledge in regards policies and guidelines for all payers.
  • Adheres to Code of Conduct and Mission & Values Statement.
  • In addition to the above job responsibilities, other duties and projects maybe assigned

Requirements

  • High School graduate or equivalent.
  • Education in medical billing or hold medical billing certification preferred.
  • Mod Med/EMA practice management system experience is a plus.
  • Understanding of basic principles of revenue cycle, accounts receivables, denial management and coding (CPT/HCPCS/ICD10).
  • Must be highly professional and an effective communicator.
  • Detail and results oriented, self-starter with a positive attitude
  • Be able to multitask, prioritize, and manage time efficiently while in a remote working environment.
  • Eagerness to learn and adapt quickly in a changing environment.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of integrity and confidentiality of medical information

Benefits

Benefits of joining Qualderm Partners:

  • Competitive Pay – Attractive compensation to reward your hard work
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage – Includes Medical, Dental, and Vision plans to keep you covered
  • Generous 401(k) Plan – Company matches 100% of the first 3%, plus 50% of the next 2%, with immediate vesting
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) – Accrue PTO from day one, plus enjoy 6 paid holidays and 2 floating holidays each year
  • Company-Paid Life Insurance – Peace of mind with basic life coverage, with the option for additional plans
  • Disability Protection – Short-term and long-term disability coverage to protect you in unexpected circumstances
  • Additional Wellness Plans – Accident, critical illness, and identity theft protection plans for extra security
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Access confidential support for personal or work-related challenges
  • Exclusive Employee Discounts – Save on products and services with special discounts just for you
  • Referral Bonus Program – Earn bonuses by referring qualified candidates to join the team

QualDerm Partners is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States in a full-time basis.

Compensation Range: $20.27 - $27.75 per hour. Final offer will be based on a combination of skills, experience, location, and internal equity.
